# OdinTree vendored into PAIRLAB

Upstream: https://github.com/Thanas-R/OdinTree
Source purpose: interactive GitHub repository explorer and visual knowledge graph.
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

This directory is an experimental vendor snapshot. Do not treat upstream architecture,
UI, or AI behavior as canonical PAIRFLOW design.

PAIRLAB may use this code as a visualization/reference substrate while keeping
PAIRFLOW/PCM governance separate.
